GL

  • Hometown: Palo, Leyte
  • Reppin: Lorem Ipsum, Alas Kwatro, Passion’s Fruit
  • Division: Visayas
  • Year Joined: 2019
  • Isabuhay 2024 Champion

GL made a name for himself in Visayas’ hip-hop scene by participating in underground battle leagues. He then competed at the 2018 Process of Illumination event in Cebu and won the championship.
